name: wakeonlan-mcp-server
description: Wake LAN machines with Wake-on-LAN magic packets from host profiles, then confirm they came up.

hosts_file.title: Hosts file
hosts_file.description: JSON file of host profiles (alias, MAC, address, and optional broadcast and ports). Leave blank if you paste the profiles below instead; set one or the other, not both.

hosts_json.title: Hosts JSON
hosts_json.description: Host profiles as inline JSON, for single-host setups. Leave blank when a hosts file is set. Stored as a secret because a profile can carry a SecureOn password.
